result.title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
result.comment: 28 pages. Project page: https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and code: https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo
result.summary: Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and our code is at https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo .

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 GameDojo：覆盖 20 款游戏、120 个 boss 战的实时交互智能体基准，由编码智能体重建环境并产出 600 小时游戏轨迹数据，据此训练 GameDojo-4B 并评测前沿模型在实时交互中的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「依观测行动、承担动作后果」的实时设定与轨迹训练、跨 boss 迁移，可能为 LVR 的状态更新、轨迹监督与泛化评价提供外部测试台，但任务是否真正依赖视觉细节的 latent 推理尚待核查。
